# Brand Vitals

> Brand Vitals: Growth partner for Egypt & Saudi. A marketing agency based in New Cairo, Cairo, Egypt, working with brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. It connects brand strategy, creative production, websites and performance marketing into one system measured on business results (revenue, orders, qualified leads), not reach. Founded by Mohamed Ahmed (Co-founder, Growth & Strategy) and Mohamed Tarek (Co-founder, Creative & Production).

Last updated: 2026-10-16

Contact: info@brandvitals.io · WhatsApp +20 109 086 1397 · Sunday to Thursday, 10:00 to 18:00 (Cairo). Work is delivered in Arabic and English; meetings for Saudi clients run on Riyadh time and invoices can be issued in EGP, SAR or USD.

## Services
- [Performance Marketing Agency](https://brandvitals.io/performance-marketing.html): Brand Vitals runs performance marketing on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat for brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia, measured on revenue, qualified leads and cost per acquisition.
- [Google Ads Management Agency](https://brandvitals.io/google-ads.html): Brand Vitals manages Google Ads in Arabic and English for businesses in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: search, Performance Max, YouTube and call tracking, built around conversions you can verify.
- [SEO Agency](https://brandvitals.io/seo.html): Brand Vitals is an Arabic SEO agency in Egypt that ranks bilingual websites in the language customers search in: technical fixes, Arabic keyword research, content and local SEO, plus readiness for AI search.
- [Branding Agency](https://brandvitals.io/branding.html): Brand Vitals is a branding agency in Cairo that builds brand strategy, naming, visual identity and guidelines in Arabic and English, then turns them into campaigns with Vitals Frames.
- [Website Design & CRO](https://brandvitals.io/web-cro.html): Brand Vitals designs bilingual websites and landing pages in Egypt and runs conversion rate optimization (CRO), so more visitors become customers from the same traffic.
- [GA4 & Server-Side Tracking](https://brandvitals.io/analytics-tracking.html): Brand Vitals sets up analytics and tracking for brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: GA4, Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, conversion tracking and dashboards, so marketing decisions run on numbers you can trust.
- [How pricing works](https://brandvitals.io/products.html): every engagement is scoped and priced by written proposal with a fixed fee; media budgets are paid straight to the platforms. VAT applies (14% Egypt, 15% Saudi Arabia).

## Industries
- [E-commerce Marketing Agency in Egypt & GCC](https://brandvitals.io/ecommerce-marketing.html): Brand Vitals grows online stores in Egypt and Saudi Arabia with paid media, creative, CRO and retention, measured on contribution margin rather than ROAS alone.
- [Real Estate Marketing in Egypt & Saudi Arabia](https://brandvitals.io/real-estate-marketing.html): Brand Vitals markets real estate projects in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: positioning, project films with Vitals Frames, paid campaigns and lead forms that qualify buyers before sales calls them.
- [Healthcare & Clinic Marketing in Egypt & the GCC](https://brandvitals.io/healthcare-marketing.html): Brand Vitals markets clinics, hospitals and healthcare groups in Egypt and the GCC, measured on bookings rather than inquiries.

## Free tools
- [Vitals Score](https://brandvitals.io/vitals-score.html): check your website's health. A free score out of 100 for speed, SEO, Arabic readiness and marketing tracking, with the three fixes that matter most.
- [Vitals Forecast](https://brandvitals.io/forecast.html): plan your numbers. Break-even ROAS, a three-month range and what has to be true to hit a target, for Egypt or Saudi Arabia. A forecast, not a guarantee.

## Reference
- [Egypt vs Saudi Arabia marketing guide](https://brandvitals.io/egypt-vs-saudi-marketing.html): Marketing in Egypt and Saudi Arabia needs two plans, not one plan in two languages. Egyptians often ask on WhatsApp and pay cash on delivery; Saudis expect local dialect, Mada or Apple Pay and VAT-inclusive prices, and buy around a few seasonal moments. Both markets work Sunday to Thursday.
- [Marketing glossary](https://brandvitals.io/glossary.html): plain definitions of ROAS, break-even ROAS, CPA, Conversions API, hreflang, cash on delivery and more.

## Articles
- [Arabic SEO is not translated SEO: a field guide](https://brandvitals.io/blog-arabic-seo-guide.html): Search intent, dialect and script: what actually ranks in Egyptian and regional Arabic search, and how to structure a bilingual site so both languages can rank.
- [From B2B to B2C: repositioning for consumers](https://brandvitals.io/blog-b2b-to-b2c.html): How a wholesale-first business can learn to speak to consumers and grow its online visibility without losing its trade customers.
- [Creative testing beats bigger budgets](https://brandvitals.io/blog-creative-testing.html): Why disciplined creative iteration, not raw spend, is the real lever in paid social, and a simple weekly testing system you can run.
- [The weekly KPI stack for e-commerce CEOs](https://brandvitals.io/blog-ecommerce-kpi-stack.html): ROAS is not enough. The five numbers that actually predict whether your e-commerce growth will hold.
- [Marketing in Egypt when prices keep moving](https://brandvitals.io/blog-egypt-pricing.html): When costs and prices change every few months, last quarter's targets stop making sense. How to keep media efficient and customers buying.
- [WhatsApp is your sales funnel in Egypt](https://brandvitals.io/blog-egypt-whatsapp.html): Most Egyptian customers want to ask before they buy. How to turn WhatsApp from a messy inbox into a measured channel.
- [Less is more: focus your catalog to lift ROAS](https://brandvitals.io/blog-focus-your-catalog.html): Why narrowing paid media down to a few hero products can multiply your return on ad spend, and how to choose them.
- [Saudi Arabia's calendar is your media plan](https://brandvitals.io/blog-ksa-seasons.html): Ramadan, Founding Day, National Day, White Friday and payday: how to plan spend and creative around the moments Saudi customers actually buy.
- [Why Saudi campaigns should test Snapchat first](https://brandvitals.io/blog-ksa-snapchat.html): Snapchat reaches a large share of young Saudis every day. Here is how to plan, brief and measure it next to Meta, TikTok and Google.
- [Prospecting vs retargeting: where growth starts](https://brandvitals.io/blog-prospecting-vs-retargeting.html): When to spend on finding new customers and when to spend on converting the ones you already have, and why retargeting ROAS can mislead you.
